correctness.rationale: The truncated downset weights are directly counted: interior rank-r points appear at 0, external rank-r points at 1, external rank-(r+1) points at r+1 or r+2, and every external point of rank at least r+2 has weight at least binomial(r+2,r)+1 > r+2. Thus in the claimed early window the contractible initial downset is augmented solely by vertices and incidence edges, never an external two-simplex. After collapsing the fixed contractible subcomplex, the quotient is a graph. Counting components, vertices and edges gives the stated integral wedge-circle ranks. Johnson-graph connectivity proves the second merger. The two graph quotients are nested, so H_1 is split injective with torsion-free cokernel; later entering high-rank points each attach to a pre-existing rank-r point, completing the exact integral degree-zero barcode. The executable checker separately tests literal weights, F_2 boundary ranks and map injectivity in 35 full parameter cases, but the proof supplies all-parameter integrality.

value.rationale: Upper-truncated Boolean lattices form a natural infinite family of rank-selected finite spaces, and the first entry of nonminimal outside points is the mathematically canonical stage where higher topology appears. The explicit transition from isolated-component birth to a bouquet of b circles, then to a connected bouquet of c circles, produces a uniform structural graph model and an integral injectivity theorem. The entire all-threshold degree-zero barcode has only two precisely determined death levels, with two binomially quantified populations; neither this finer information nor the positive-degree graph emergence follows merely from correctness of elementary union-find. These exact natural invariants provide a reproducible benchmark for finite-space furtherness persistent homology, while no unsupported all-degree conclusion is asserted.
